messages.subject: barplot ggplot2
parts:
Hi All,

I have a question in terms of the legend position. The legend name is long, and I tried a lot of ways, but I could not place it in appropriate position. I wish I can put the legend in the right middle within the figure. Any one can help me on this?

My raw data is attached. 

Here is my code:

origdata.wide=read.csv("F:/Chen/HongmeiChen/Geobacter_PCA/localization/distribution.csv")
library(reshape2)
origdata.wide$subject <- factor(origdata.wide$Subject)
origdata.long=melt(origdata.wide, id.vars=c("Subject","Localization"))
ggplot(data=origdata.long, aes(x=Localization,y=value,fill=variable))+geom_bar(stat="identity",position=position_dodge())+ylab("protein fraction")+theme_minimal()+coord_flip()+
 theme(legend.position=c(0.5,0.5))
ggsave(file = "bar_chart.tiff")




Thank you,

Chen

messages.subject: Re: barplot ggplot2
parts:
There are many setting you can change to the legend. http://docs.ggplot2.org/0.9.2.1/theme.html  http://docs.ggplot2.org/0.9.3.1/guide_legend.html

One of the easiest is to make the legend smaller.
 
library(reshape2)
##load grid to use function unit()
library(grid)

theme(legend.position=c(0.7,0.56),legend.key.size=unit(0.3,"cm"))

I also suggest you make legend show in two rows, change  the angle of x axis label etc.
